displayName: loop-sessions: skill posts refused as malformed

conditions.displayName: invalid skill payloads above 50 in 1 h

documentation.content:
More than fifty skill posts in an hour failed a field rule. An emitter (the Claude Code hook script, a mirrored SKILL.md's beacon line, a reconciler) is sending a shape this server refuses, and it drops every 400 silently, so the rows are lost until it is fixed. The rejected line names the field.

gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name=\"loop-sessions\" AND jsonPayload.message=\"skill invocation rejected\"' --freshness=30m --format='value(timestamp,jsonPayload.reason,jsonPayload.token_state,jsonPayload.source_token_id,jsonPayload.platform,jsonPayload.field)'. Group by `field` and `platform`: one field on one platform is that emitter's bug (the hook script, the beacon line, a reconciler or a platform monitor); `origin` on a platform whose token was just minted is a token minted with the wrong `allowed_origins`, fixed by minting again; `agent_platform` is a body naming a platform other than its token's (reason `platform_mismatch` on the line).

Runbook: examples/deploy-gcp/README.md#runbook-source-tokens
